name.en: Yā Ṣābiran Abshir - O Patient One, Rejoice

ara: يَا صَابِرًا أَبْشِرْ وَبَشِّرْ مَنْ صَبَرْ
وَصَفَتْ لَهُ الْأَوْقَاتُ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْكَدَرْ
وَاعْلَمْ بِأَنَّ الْكَوْنَ مَطْبُوعٌ عَلَى التَّـ
وَاشْكُرْ عَلَىٰ مَا سَاءَ مِنْ حَالٍ وَسَرّْ
en: yā ṣābiran abshir wa-bashshir man ṣabar
bi-n-naṣri wa-l-faraji l-qarībi wa-bi-ẓ-ẓafar
nāla ṣ-ṣabūru bi-ṣabrihī mā yartajī
wa-ṣafat lahu l-awqātu min baʿdi l-kadar
fa-ṣbir ʿala l-miḥani l-qawāṣidi wa-ntaẓir
farajan tadūlu bihī diwalu l-qadar
wa-idha l-ḥawādithu aẓlamat wa-tanakkarat
fa-skun wa-iyyāka t-taḥarruka wa-l-ḥadhar
inna n-nawāʾiba ka-s-saḥāʾibi tanjalī
fī surʿatin wa-wujūduhā yuḍḥī khabar
wa-idhā taṭūlu iqāmatun min ḥādithin
kānat mubashshiratan bi-ṭūli l-muntaẓar
fa-ṣbir hadāka llāhu ṣabra l-atqiyā
al-abriyāʾi th-thābitīna lada l-ghiyar
wa-ʿlam bi-anna l-kawna maṭbūʿun ʿala t-ta-
-ghyīri wa-t-takdīri fa-mʿin fi n-naẓar
wa-ghnam zamānaka rāḥatan wa-tarawwuḥā
wa-daʿi l-humūma fa-innahā maḥḍu ḍ-ḍarar
wa-dkhul mayādīna t-tawakkuli wa-r-riḍā
wa-shkur ʿalā mā sāʾa min ḥālin wa-sarr
wa-qtad bi-tāji l-aṣfiyā ʿalami l-hudā
zayni l-wujūdi muḥammadin khayri l-bashar
O patient one, rejoice, and give glad tidings to whoever is patient
Of victory, of relief close at hand, and of triumph
The patient one attains through his patience what he hopes for
And his times turn clear for him after turbidity
So be patient through the trials that strike, and wait
For a relief brought round by the turns of destiny
And when events grow dark and turn hostile
Then be still, and beware of restless stirring and of alarm
For misfortunes are like clouds, they clear away
Swiftly, and their presence becomes a mere tale
And when some event stays for a long time
It is a glad sign of how great the awaited [relief] will be
So be patient, may Allah guide you, with the patience of the God-fearing
The guiltless, who stand firm when fortunes change
And know that creation is stamped with
Change and turbidity, so look deeply
Make the most of your time with ease and refreshment
And leave worries aside, for they are sheer harm
Enter the fields of trust [in Allah] and contentment
And give thanks for whatever state saddens or gladdens
And follow the crown of the pure ones, the banner of guidance
The adornment of existence, Muhammad, the best of mankind
